seat #5 do they get to go again?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
John Ferretti wrote:
>
> I player #4 plays Dramatic Upheaval and it passes and player #4 moves to
> seat #5 do they get to go again?

After moving to seat #5, it is still her turn (she moved during her minion
phase). After concluding her minion phase and then handling her influence
and discard phases, her turn will end.

The next player clockwise (the player to her left) will then take the next
turn. [3]
